changelog: Share card fixes: Bible cards now show the correct version label and badge (not always KJV) for ABAB, CEBug, NASB, BSB, GNV, RV, GNT, and HOT. Confession share cards now include a 'Proof Texts' toggle in Show Fields to hide the scripture proofs. Added distinct badge colors for all versions. Hebrew text align is now shown as locked (RTL) instead of a non-functional dropdown.
